scope: Every exposed mechanics field is enumerated. Familiar death/HP lexical matches are candidates; semantic qualifier completeness outside the one declared contract is unassessed.

candidates.value: Brownie (PHB p.66): the magic-user gains Dexterity equal to the brownie’s 18, is never surprised, and gains +2 on all saving throws. Pseudo-dragon (MM pp.79–80): a companion shares its 35% magic resistance while touching it; it uses limited telepathy and can convey sight and hearing to its companion within 24″. Imp or quasit familiar (MM pp.54, 80): telepathy shares the familiar’s senses up to one mile; within 1″ the master gains 25% magic resistance and regenerates 1 hit point per melee round. Within one mile the master gains one level of ability; at more than a mile the source says the character loses one level, and if the familiar is killed the character loses four levels. Once a week the familiar can contact a lower plane like commune with six questions.
A normal familiar has 2–4 HP and AC 7; while within 12″, its HP are added to its master's total.
If the familiar dies, its master permanently loses twice the familiar's HP.

contracts.value: If the familiar dies, its master permanently loses twice the familiar's HP.
